svg.title: Markdown Hash Runs
svg.desc: A left-right comparison graphic showing 11 Ligconsolata Next samples. The left side is shaped from a smoke-built font with liga, dlig, and calt enabled, and the right side is the same raw ASCII source with ligatures disabled.
svg.text: Markdown hashes get countable badges or unnumbered long rails.
Markdown 井号显示可数徽标，长 run 则连成无编号横线。

g.text: Badges only cover Markdown heading levels 2 through 6.
数字徽标只覆盖 Markdown 二级到六级标题。
Seven or more hashes connect without a number; they are treated like long runs, not heading levels.
七个及以上井号只连成长 run，不再标数字，也不伪装成标题层级。
